card.fact_statement: The International Justice Mission – Kenya (IJM) was one of the civil organizations that criticized the charging of protesters.
card.source_span: Several civil organizations, including the Law Society of Kenya and the International Justice Mission – Kenya (IJM), have suggested that the arresting and charging of protesters with serious crimes are meant to suppress dissent

target_qa_variants.question: Ni shirika gani maalum la kiraia, pamoja na Chama cha Wanasheria cha Kenya, lililodokeza kuwa kuwashtaki waandamanaji kwa uhalifu mkubwa kulilenga kukandamiza upinzani?
target_qa_variants.source_span: Several civil organizations, including the Law Society of Kenya and the International Justice Mission – Kenya (IJM), have suggested that the arresting and charging of protesters with serious crimes are meant to suppress dissent
target_qa_variants.translation_note: Translated 'Law Society of Kenya' to its standard Swahili name 'Chama cha Wanasheria cha Kenya'. Kept 'International Justice Mission – Kenya' in English as it is the official registered name of the NGO.

backtranslation_en.question: Which specific civil society organization, along with the Law Society of Kenya, suggested that charging protesters with serious crimes was aimed at suppressing opposition?
